narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to raise awareness and critique gender-based double standards in parenting. The speaker observes that society often unfairly blames mothers for childcare issues while excusing fathers under the guise of 'working hard to provide.' She highlights the reality of dual-income families where mothers manage both professional and domestic responsibilities, questioning why fathers are not held to the same standard of active parenting.
